#TrafficUpdate: Tragic Accident at Molete, Ibadan this morning
A major fatal accident has occurred involving a trailer carrying a container, many Motorcycles and tricycles (Keke NAPEP) are under the loaded container.
A heavy-duty container fell off a trailer, crushing multiple motorcycles and tricycles in its path.
Sadly, several people are reported to  have sustained various degrees of injuries and have been rushed to nearby hospitals for emergency treatment.
Traffic management authorities and security officials are currently on-site managing the chaos and attempting to clear the wreckage.

#RoadSafety #BreakingNews #Ibadan #DiscoverIbadan
